research_question: On sealed synthetic European power-market investigations that require evidence from five sequential audit gates, does retained Responses API reasoning improve decision quality over a stateless rolling history, and does forced compaction preserve retained-state quality with fewer output tokens?

artifacts.pre_run_disclosure: Only hashes are committed before execution. Model-visible cases and evaluator-only labels remain in the ignored private directory.
artifacts.post_run_disclosure: After all results are frozen, publish the exact cases, answer key, and complete run records so the first evaluation is auditable but cannot be reused as an unseen set.

run_matrix.temperature: not sent; unsupported for this model configuration

calibration.set: public development episode regime-dependent-signal; excluded from the sealed analysis
calibration.interpretation: The compaction condition is a deliberately forced short-context stress test. It is not evidence about a normal 200,000-token production threshold.

analysis.repeat_handling: Average paired repeat-level values within episode before inference.
analysis.hypothesis_test: two-sided exact episode-level sign-flip test when at most 20 nonzero episode deltas

budget.rule: Before each paid job, stop if recorded estimated spend plus the next-run reserve would exceed the cap. An incomplete matrix is not claim-supporting.

interpretation_limits: The eight cases are synthetic seeded investigations, not live trading data and not evidence of market alpha.
The set stresses the exact failure mode under study: final decisions require evidence older than the stateless three-action window.
The 1,000-token threshold is a forced-compaction test selected on an excluded public development case.
The gpt-5.6-sol alias is recorded rather than a dated model snapshot because no dated Sol snapshot was selected; response model IDs are retained.
Only the primary composite-score contrast is treated as confirmatory; other rules are secondary and reported without selective omission.
